notes.title: Major Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I've implemented a large number of fixes, both to hero and enemy skills, and I've tightening up the storyline a bit, too.

[list]
[*]Aedric's Call to Arms now only affects allies that haven't fallen
[*]Ensnared now has an idle animation, matching other disabling status effects 
[*]Damien's Arcane Barrage now deals more damage
[*]Damien's Analyticus now debuffs willpower by 20%, and has a 4 round cooldown
[*]Damien's Astral Theft now deals more damage
[*]The Conscripted Samurai's Iron Will now has a 4 round cooldown
[*]Athena's Divine Grace will no longer revive fallen allies if Empower Spell is active
[*]Enemies should no longer attempt to dominate stunned heroes, locking them in an endless cycle
[*]Encinder's higher level animation now anchors below targets, allowing it to be seen clearly
[*]Fragility won't kill guest allies if they don't act in time on Storyteller or Normal difficulty
[*]Two instances where the main character's custom name wasn't respected have been fixed
[*]Fire damage from Flaming Fists can no longer be blocked if the base attack lands
[/list]


As always, your feedback is appreciated. Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
The demo for the game has been updated, including many QoL features, re-balancing, and more!

Fixes

[list]
[*] The header for Aedric's auras now says that only one can be active at any time.
[*] Sunrays no longer display through transitions and fades.
[*] Storyteller difficulty now grants immunity to Doom.
[/list]


As always, your feedback is appreciated. Thank you!

notes.title: 4th Mini Update
notes.content:
A few fixes this time...

[list]
[*] More spelling errors have been corrected.
[*] Gems can now be attached to starter gear.
[*] Aedric's elemental blades header now states that its damage caps at 10 points.
[*] The description for Fae Covenant now includes the user in its effect.
[*] The Brilliant Charm of Meditation can now only be worn by mages.
[*] Aedric's thoughts during the inn scenes now use the dark background, showing that he's thinking, instead of talking out loud.
[*] A guest character's level-up quotes have been changed to better reflect their personality.
[*] The speaker's name in an ending scene has been centered.
[*] Due to feedback, the first series of Chain Fights are now a little easier.
[*] If an enemy hits with an element-infused physical attack, it is now impossible to block the elemental damage if the first attack connected.
[*] Transitions in Act 2 and later should be smoother, now.
[/list]


As always, your feedback is appreciated. Thank you!

notes.title: 3rd Mini Update
notes.content:
A few small fixes for today.

[list]
[*] Prayer of Guidance's tooltip has been corrected. Before, it was reading 50%, when it should've been a 20% increase to Hit Chance.
[*] The tier 2 symbol for Athena has been renamed, correcting a spelling error.

notes.title: We have Screenshots!
notes.content:
Want to keep track of your favourite moments in the game? Want to show off your character builds? This guide will help you enable screenshots so you can!

[olist]
[*] Right Click [b]Trials of Kokoro[/b] in your game library.
[*] Click Properties...
[*] At the bottom of the window, in the Launch Options field, paste "--in-process-gpu", without the quotes.
[*] Close the window, and run the game!
[/olist]

Now, the Steam Overlay should work and you can use F12 to take screenshots!

Cheers everyone, and I hope you have a great week!

Please join the official Discord. I'd love to hear your thoughts on the game! 

discord.gg/W9gBn3Ccvx

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
A small update this early Saturday morning.

[list]
[*] I squashed a bug where the Fear status couldn't be removed via Encourage, leaving the target paralyzed for the rest of battle. The affected character should be able to act normally now once Encouraged.

[/list]

Happy adventuring, everyone!

notes.title: Trials of Kokoro is Now Available!
notes.content: Trials of Kokoro is now available for purchase! Join Aedric as he fights to reclaim himself, and experience the emotional journey that he faces along the way. In this Visual Novel RPG, exciting turn-based battles merge with a gripping narrative about facing one's past, the meaning of family, and the loss of innocence.

notes.title: Trials of Kokoro releasing 5/23!
notes.content:
After nearly 2 years of development, the game is ready for release on May 23, 2023!

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned! You'll be able to join Aedric, Rhea, and Athena on their adventure, soon!

I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Trials of Kokoro's Demo has been updated!!
notes.content:
Trials of Kokoro's demo has been updated with a lot of new content!

It now contains -

[list]
[*] Official title page graphic
[*] Tutorials that help explain aspects of the game, complete with pictures
[*] More gems added for further customization. Some are dropped, but others must be stolen!
[*] Custom icons for all stats, items, skills, and spells
[*] Ability to fast forward through all non-battle dialogue if desired
[*] Updates to enemy balancing. Now, all enemies carry one item that can be stolen!
[*] Aedric's official theme has been added to the game!
[/list]

Trials of Kokoro is a turn-based RPG, focusing on party management, including skill and equipment upgrades, item management, and customizeable builds. Guide Aedric, Rhea, and Athena on their adventure in the wilds of the mysterious country of Hinode. The demo spans roughly 2.5 hours of content, and will comprise a big part of the first act.

The storyline is emotional and is told like a visual novel, focusing on themes of personal identity, facing one's past, and accepting oneself.

Access the demo by clicking the [b]Download Demo[/b] button on the right side of the page, about halfway down.
